tasks.label: SunSwitcher: build release
tasks.command: cargo build --release --locked --bin sunswitcher; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $src = 'C:\Temp\sunswitcher-build\release\sunswitcher.exe'; $dstDir = 'C:\SunSwitcher'; $dst = Join-Path $dstDir 'sunswitcher.exe'; $old = Join-Path $dstDir 'sunswitcher.exe.old'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dstDir | Out-Null; if (Test-Path $old) { Remove-Item -Force $old -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path $dst) { try { Copy-Item -Force $src $dst -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Move-Item -Force $dst $old; Copy-Item -Force $src $dst } } else { Copy-Item -Force $src $dst }
